command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$nodes=@('PE1','PE2','PE3','SH_AR','SH_Core','BJHQ_CSR1000V_GW_01','Core_SW_01','Core_SW_02','FW_01','FW_02'); foreach(`$n in `$nodes){foreach(`$c in @('display current-configuration','show running-config')){`$ec=[uri]::EscapeDataString(`$c); `$u1='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_02/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+`$ec; `$u2='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_03/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+`$ec; try{`$o1=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u1 -Method Get).output; `$o2=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u2 -Method Get).output; if(`$o1 -notlike 'Error:*' -and `$o2 -notlike 'Error:*'){`$d=Compare-Object (`$o1 -split '\r?\n') (`$o2 -split '\r?\n') | Where-Object {`$_.InputObject -notmatch 'Last configuration|certificate|engineid|Current configuration|license udi'}; if(`$d){Write-Output ('=== '+`$n+' ==='); `$d | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 300}; break}}catch{}}}"
